goal: For temporary-ID smoke opportunities, resolve the six directed issue-body references into the correct real issues and establish the two requested parent-child relationships, independently joined to protected safe-output receipts.
acceptance: A protected initial-attempt host receipt maps aw_test01, aw_test02 and aw_test03 to distinct stable GitHub issues; independent cutoff-valid bodies prove the six exact directed references, complete historical graph facts prove both children belong to that parent, and a protected comment receipt proves targeting of the mapped parent. Each known resolved reference counts independently of other missing dimensions.
filters: Only github/gh-aw, exact immutable reviewed workflow profiles and a protected safe_outputs host execution bind the mapping; editable body markers are discovery only.
Initial attempt only; reruns remain inventoried but do not inflate delivered references.
The six body slots are parent-to-child1, parent-to-child2, child1-to-parent, child1-to-child2, child2-to-parent and child2-to-child1.
Two native graph links are measured separately; a Related to footer or fallback comment is not a parent relationship.
Mutable bodies observed after cutoff require a platform last-edit/update timestamp no later than cutoff; otherwise their historical state is unknown.
Current graph edges require exhaustive historical add/remove facts to reconstruct the cutoff; current graph state alone is not backdated.
No proof from successful runs, jobs, agent summaries, evals, unresolved placeholders, issue existence, edited footer IDs or group-parent issues.
Empty populations and all-unknown populations score null, never zero. A known incorrect slot scores zero only for that assessed dimension.
3-8 versus original 4-8 format, agent engine, telemetry and report-format changes do not alter the fixed aw_test01/02/03 goal. Other source changes require review.
The source describes the third ID as eight characters, but all three actual fixtures have six suffix characters. No broad length-coverage claim is made.
collection: Acquire the complete cutoff-bounded Actions inventory and every attempt, reuse the complete shared output-history discovery partitions, inspect all matching issue identities, acquire protected host job/log/artifact receipts, pin immutable workflow/runtime source, and independently project GitHub bodies and parent/sub-issue histories. Offline scoring never calls GitHub.

antecedent.outcome: Correct cross-references and parent-child issue graphs can exist without this workflow.
antecedent.reason: No retained pre-adoption protected temporary-ID mapping and matching historical bodies/graph receipts are supplied. The workflow was actually added against its first parent, rather than inferred from a shallow boundary. No pre-adoption baseline or zero is invented.

metricDisposition.temporaryIdResolutionRateAtLeast0.95: experiment guardrail only; the exact six slots must have correct targets
metricDisposition.aicAndDuration: not measured; no matching independently retained cost exposure
metricDisposition.groupParentAndIssueClosure: normal lifecycle, not acceptance or rejection of temporary-ID behavior
metricDisposition.lengthCoverage: not demonstrated by these fixed same-length fixture IDs

signal: Native resolved-reference counts only. No keep bar, trend, causation or cost claim without complete comparable periods.
